nodes.prompt:
TASK: Audit the Hono server code for bugs, with emphasis on auth, and produce a findings report.
DELIVERABLE: A file report at /tmp/dbms-audit-server.md (bounded, <=5k tokens) with a numbered list of findings. Each finding: severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), file:line, a one-sentence description, and why it is a bug (with a concrete trigger). If none, state none.
SCOPE: Read ONLY /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/src/server/app.ts and /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/src/server/auth.ts and /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/src/index.ts. Write ONLY /tmp/dbms-audit-server.md. Do NOT edit any other file.
Focus on: auth (signup/login/me/logout, session cookie handling, password hashing, timing, error responses), RBAC role checks (requireAccess), input validation, error-response shape (must be JSON {message} - never bare status), handler throws that become 500s, SQL injection, and any correctness bugs.
VERIFY: /tmp/dbms-audit-server.md exists and contains a numbered findings list; report the file path and findings count.
STOP WHEN: the report is written with every finding (or none) documented.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Audit the database schema, migrations, and data-layer code for bugs, with emphasis on anything that could cause runtime 500s or data corruption, and produce a findings report.
DELIVERABLE: A file report at /tmp/dbms-audit-db.md (bounded, <=5k tokens) with a numbered list of findings. Each finding: severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), file:line, a one-sentence description, and why it is a bug (with a concrete trigger). If none, state none.
SCOPE: Read ONLY /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/migrations/0001_init.sql, /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/migrations/0002_seed.sql, /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/test/d1.ts, and /home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/test/schema.test.ts. Write ONLY /tmp/dbms-audit-db.md. Do NOT edit any other file.
Focus on: FK integrity (users.person_id references person), the delete-cascade ordering in app.ts (the /trees/:id and /persons/:pid deletes), CHECK constraints, seed-data consistency (does seed satisfy the schema), migration idempotency, and anything that would make a valid request throw a 500.
VERIFY: /tmp/dbms-audit-db.md exists and contains a numbered findings list; report the file path and findings count.
STOP WHEN: the report is written with every finding (or none) documented.
